resources.string: Repeat the mantra in your mind, at a steady pace.
Repeat mentally, at a steady pace.
For mental japa, use the Sandhya counter.
Take a moment to settle in. There are three ways to repeat the Gayatri mantra.
You say the mantra out loud, so people nearby can hear it. This can help while you are learning the pronunciation.
Your lips and tongue move as you repeat the mantra very softly, so only you can hear it.
Repeat the mantra silently in your mind, without moving your lips, tongue or throat.
Our mentor recommends mental repetition for daily Gayatri japa. Keep a steady pace, as in the reference audio. There is no need to hurry.

In Sandhya, you can count mental or soft repetitions yourself, or record your count afterwards. You do not need the microphone.\n\nUse Practice to listen and learn the pronunciation. The Japa tab currently listens to spoken repetitions. Playing the reference audio does not add to your count.
